notes: Deployment-scoped runtime facts for the ProjectHub deployment of Scout. Facts with a `provider` field are emitted only when that provider is actually configured; ungated facts describe this deployment's topology. Other deployments declare their own file or omit it. Generated config facts (provider/model/deadline/rate-limit) come from lib/deployment-facts.js, not this file.

facts.text: This deployment does not run the primary language model locally. Query/session handling, retrieval, evidence selection, relationship checks, factual validation, telemetry, and persistence run in the Scout backend process; normal generative inference is hosted by Cloudflare Workers AI. A local provider is only an optional fallback when explicitly configured.

This deployment keeps its normal generative inference inside Cloudflare Workers AI's included free allocation of 10,000 neurons per day, resetting at 00:00 UTC — an account-level shared allocation, not a per-visitor allowance. If the free allocation is exhausted, the provider can reject inference with a rate/allocation error; this deployment does not intentionally switch to a paid-only model as an automatic fallback.

This chat is free to visitors because this deployment's inference stays inside the provider's included free allocation and the hosting uses free-tier services. The model still consumes measurable tokens and provider usage units, so 'free' means within the included allocation, not costless. Cloudflare's public Workers AI paid-usage reference is $0.011 per 1,000 neurons beyond the included allocation on Workers Paid. A metered-value estimate is not the same as an actual billed charge.

In this deployment, the public widget is served from GitHub Pages and the chat backend runs separately on a free-tier GCP VM that calls the configured inference provider. The architecture keeps model context small by retrieving only relevant evidence instead of sending the entire knowledge base for every question.
